headline: GTM Readiness Audit: Business Model & Messaging Deficits Mapped to 12-Item Remediation Plan (T3 Execution)
highlights: Business Model Gap: Pricing framework validation requires 3 evidence streams—credit-burn rate from paying pilots, independent WTP study (15-20 People Ops leaders), and win/loss pricing objection tracking
Messaging Readiness Gap: Core value narrative ('3x faster, 2x cheaper, 95% brand fidelity') must be tested in discovery calls; requires messaging playbook, sales deck, one-pager, and async demo video
Launch Infrastructure: Analytics dashboard code-complete; gap is real customer data seeding once T3 pilots launch (2-week effort)
8-Week Execution Timeline: BM track (3 workstreams) and MSG track (3 workstreams) run parallel; critical path is WTP study + messaging playbook (6-8 weeks)
Decision Framework: Go/pivot/no-go decision gate at T3 Week 7-8 based on pricing validation (median WTP ≥$20K, ≥70% resonance on messaging narrative)
Resource Allocation: 420-530 total hours (10-13 FTE-weeks) across Product Head, Strategic Analyst, Sales Ops, Marketing, Data Engineer, Discovery Lead
Risk Mitigation: 5 key risks identified (sparse pilot data, low WTP response rates, late objection stabilization, narrative non-resonance, playbook adoption gaps) with contingencies
Success Metrics: Credit-burn ≤$200/mo per customer, median WTP ≥$20K (60%+ willing at $24K anchor), ≥70% narrative resonance, ≥80% closing rate at $24K
T4 Runway: By end of T3, will have market-validated pricing, tested messaging, and real customer usage data enabling 10+ pilot scaling by T4

next_actions.label: Kick off Business Model track: Instrument pilot customer credit consumption and begin WTP study recruiting
Finalize Messaging track: Complete narrative testing in discovery calls, create playbook, design sales collateral
